title: One-arm Assisted Pull-ups - B
texts: One-arm assisted pull-ups using a resistance band or pulley

4 sets per arm alternating arms on each set. Rest for 90 seconds between sets.

One arm pull assisted pull ups can be completed using a resistance band or pulley and counter-weights. Aim to use the minimal amount of assistance as possible to complete the prescribed sets and reps of the workout progression. 

If you cannot complete the desired sets and reps, increase the assistance used. The aim is to be consistent in form and make sure to complete the full range of each pull up.
